shortlist.notes: Personal skill reads this absolute-ish path via llms_peer_review repo root (parent of process/), not the current workspace. Override with --shortlist or --llms-root. Proposer/critic phases use this value track (quality/cost). Phase-5 leader uses leader_selection instead.

leader_selection.notes: Phase 5 leader = highest pure quality (calculation.quality.value) among the phase-2 proposer roster / phase0 participants — no /est_cost. Does not require a quality-only shortlist from llms_peer_review; the skill re-ranks from ranking_calculation_latest.json. If that file is missing, falls back to the capability_weighted shortlist and sets leader_selection_error.

phase1_cycle.notes: File an LLM writes in its proposals/ or revisions/ folder when it has no decision drafts (dNN_slug.md). The phase-1 cycle counts that folder as complete. Keep in sync with llms_peer_review process/phases/phase1_questions.md.

dispatch.notes: Phase 1/4 reuse phase-2 proposer ranking. Phase 3 prefer *_phase3_* / generic_phase3_critique. Phase 5 prefer leader apps. Revisions use the same phases 0–5 under a new timestamped round (see revision_rounds.md). unique_provider=true: never assign two Task families from the same vendor (OpenAI, Anthropic, …) in one peer-review roster. proposer_slots is the hard ceiling when roster_sizing.max_slots is unset.

roster_sizing.notes: Auto-size proposer count from unique-provider shortlist scores. Always take min_slots (fill with fallback if needed). Beyond min_slots, include next only if s_k/s_1 >= tau AND s_k/s_{k-1} >= rho. Cliff (rho) is never evaluated inside the minimum floor.
